Ordinance No. 2643 Adopted 8/11/26 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 8.16.010 OF THE DERBY MUNICIPAL CODE, PROVIDING FOR ADOPTION BY REFERENCE OF THE INTERNATIONAL FIRE CODE, 2024 EDITION; ALL PERTAINING TO THE PREVENTION AND SUPPRESSION OF FIRE AND PROTECTION OF LIFE SAFETY; ADOPTING CERTAIN AMENDMENTS THERETO; AND REPEALING ORIGINAL SECTIONS 8.16.010 AND 8.16.020 OF THE DERBY MUNICIPAL CODE.

Ordinance No. 2639 Adopted 5/27/26 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE ZONING REGULATIONS OF THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS, AS FIRST ADOPTED BY ORDINANCE NO. 940 AND SUBSEQUENTLY AMENDED, MOST RECENTLY INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE VIA ORDINANCE NO. 2500 AND MOST RECENTLY AMENDED BY ORDINANCE NO. 2605.

Ordinance No. 2637 Adopted 5/12/26 AN ORDINANCE RELATING TO THE POSSESSION AND CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR AND ENHANCED CEREAL MALT BEVERAGE ON PUBLIC PROPERTY; AMENDING SECTION 5.16.040 OF THE DERBY MUNICIPAL CODE AND REPEALING THE ORIGINAL SECTION 5.16.040 AND PROVIDING SUBSTITUTE PROVISIONS THEREFOR.

Ordinance No. 2636 Adopted 5/12/26 AN ORDINANCE RELATING TO STIPENDS FOR MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNING BODY; AMENDING SECTION 2.04.010 OF THE DERBY MUNICIPAL CODE AND REPEALING THE ORIGINAL SECTION 2.04.010 AND PROVIDING SUBSTITUTE PROVISIONS THEREFOR.

Ordinance No. 2634 Adopted 3/24/26 AN ORDINANCE LEVYING DELINQUENT AND UNPAID SANITARY SEWER AND STORMWATER USE CHARGES AS A SPECIAL ASSESSMENT UPON CERTAIN REAL PROPERTY LOCATED WITHIN THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS.

Ordinance No. 2633 Adopted 3/10/26 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 2.04.020 OF THE DERBY MUNICIPAL CODE, PRESCRIBING DAYS AND TIME FOR REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE CITY'S GOVERNING BODY AND GRANTING AUTHORITY TO ALTER THE SCHEDULE BY GOVERNING BODY ACTION; AND REPEALING ORIGINAL SECTION 2.04.020 OF SAID CODE.

Ordinance No. 2632 Adopted 3/10/26 AN ORDINANCE REZONING REAL PROPERTY LOCATED WITHIN THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS, FROM R-1 "SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT" TO B-3 "GENERAL BUSINESS DISTRICT" AND AMENDING THE OFFICIAL ZONING MAP OR MAPS OF THE CITY TO REFLECT SUCH AMENDMENT, ALL PURSUANT TO THE ZONING REGULATIONS OF THE CITY.

Ordinance No. 2631 Adopted 2/10/26 AN ORDINANCE APPROVING THE SURVEY AND DESCRIPTION OF CERTAIN INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY WITHIN THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS, ACQUISITION OF WHICH IS NECESSARY FOR RECONSTRUCTION AND IMPROVEMENT OF NORTH ROCK ROAD WITHIN AND BEYOND THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS, FROM FREEDOM DRIVE TO ONE-HALF MILE NORTH OF 55TH STREET AND 55TH STREET FROM APPROXIMATELY 1000' WEST OF ROCK ROAD TO APPROXIMATELY 1250' EAST OF ROCK ROAD, TOGETHER WITH APPROACHES, STORMWATER SEWERS, DITCHES AND OTHER DRAINAGE IMPROVEMENTS, TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES, AND OTHER IMPROVEMENTS APPURTENANT THERETO; DECLARING IT TO BE A PUBLIC NECESSITY TO ACQUIRE SAID INTERESTS BY PROCEEDINGS IN EMINENT DOMAIN FOR SUCH PURPOSES; AND DIRECTING THE CITY'S ATTORNEY TO MAKE PROPER APPLICATION TO THE DISTRICT COURT OF SEDGWICK COUNTY, KANSAS, FOR APPOINTMENT OF APPRAISERS TO APPRAISE SAID INTERESTS AND TO CONDUCT PROCEEDINGS IN EMINENT DOMAIN RELATIVE THERETO.
Ordinance No. 2630 Adopted 1/27/26 AN ORDINANCE INCLUDING, INCORPORATING AND ANNEXING CERTAIN LAND INTO THE LIMITS AND BOUNDARIES OF THE CITY OF DERBY, KANSAS.
